params.prompt: A four-second continuous underwater marine-fish computer-vision demonstration, using this exact image as the first frame. All FIVE original fish remain visible and recognizable. Keep their original separate depth and vertical positions so they never overlap. Preserve normal fish anatomy, species-like body shapes and horizontal swimming posture. The five thin blue detection rectangles and five translucent blue silhouette segmentation masks are the actual visual topic: each rectangle continuously translates and resizes tightly around its OWN fish, and each mask continuously conforms to that fish's changing fins, tail and body silhouette. Exactly one tracked box and one fitted mask per fish in EVERY frame. All five fish stay fully in frame, no new fish enter. Camera stays steady as an observation camera while water caustics ripple naturally across the sandy seabed and particles drift gently. The fish's clearly visible swimming drives the motion. Keep the original rocks and seabed fixed and realistic. No cuts, no scene change, no new labels or numbers, no detached boxes, no empty boxes, no masks painted on water, no morphing or flatfish, no static photo pan or zoom. Crisp restrained marine AI visualization with natural underwater light.
